categories.main_business_segments: Jacobs Solutions Inc. operates two main business segments: Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities (I&AF), which provides end-to-end solutions for complex challenges in infrastructure, water, environmental, life sciences, and advanced manufacturing; and a majority investment in PA Consulting, a global innovation and transformation consulting firm. The company previously operated Critical Mission Solutions (CMS) and portions of Divergent Solutions (DVS), but these were spun off in September 2024 and are now reported as discontinued operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Jacobs leverages advanced consulting, planning, architecture, design, engineering, and program management, increasingly integrating data science, digital, and AI-enabled solutions. The company emphasizes technology-enabled expertise, including digital architecture, data analytics, software development, and cybersecurity, as well as sustainability and climate response tools such as its proprietary Evolve tool for project sustainability assessment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jacobs serves a diverse client base including national, state, and local governments, as well as multinational and local private sector clients across sectors such as advanced manufacturing, cities & places, energy, environmental, life sciences, transportation, and water. PA Consulting serves both public and private sector clients, including major corporations and government agencies in consumer goods, defense, energy, financial services, health, and transport.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with key regions including the United States, Europe (notably the UK), Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific. In fiscal 2024, approximately 31% of revenue was generated outside the U.S., reflecting a significant international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jacobs operates primarily as a downstream professional services and consulting provider, delivering value-added services directly to end clients. The company is positioned at the end of the supply chain, focusing on design, engineering, consulting, and lifecycle management rather than manufacturing or raw material supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Jacobs' strategic focus is on high-growth sectors aligned with long-term trends such as infrastructure renewal, sustainability, and digital transformation. The company invests in three growth accelerators: Climate Response (energy transition, decarbonization, resilience), Consulting & Advisory, and Data Solutions (digital and AI-enabled services). R&D and innovation are directed toward sustainability, digital transformation, and technology-enabled solutions, with ongoing portfolio reshaping through acquisitions and divestitures.
categories.revenue_model: Jacobs generates revenue primarily through professional services contracts, including consulting, design, engineering, and program management. Contracts are a mix of cost-reimbursable (69% in 2024) and fixed-price (31%), with revenue recognized over time as performance obligations are satisfied. PA Consulting contributes through consulting and advisory fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jacobs competes with global engineering, consulting, and technology firms such as AECOM, Tetra Tech, WSP, Arcadis, Bechtel, Arup, Stantec, Parsons, Accenture, Schneider Electric, Capgemini, IBM, Deloitte, KPMG, PwC, Bain, BCG, and McKinsey. The company is positioned as a leader in high-value, technology-enabled, and sustainability-focused consulting and infrastructure solutions, often partnering with competitors on large projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2024, Jacobs reported $11.5 billion in revenue from continuing operations, with a 6% year-over-year increase. Net earnings attributable to Jacobs from continuing operations were $612.8 million, up 61.6% from the prior year. The company maintains a strong backlog of $21.8 billion and has demonstrated consistent growth in both revenue and profitability, supported by a robust balance sheet and global operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jacobs differentiates itself through its integrated, end-to-end solutions that combine deep domain expertise with advanced digital and sustainability capabilities. The company emphasizes its ability to address complex, interconnected global challenges, deliver high-impact outcomes, and advance sustainability and social value for clients and communities. Its unique value lies in its science-based, technology-enabled approach and commitment to creating a more connected and sustainable world.
